The T & P Cell of the College is functioning with well-equipped block, is in tune with the requirements of the visiting MNC’s. It liaisons with industries of repute and arranges campus interviews & internships for the students. We focus on the current needs of the industry and create awareness in the students of various opportunities and growth available to them, well in advance. The Head- Training & Placements Ms. Shantha K Nuthalapati with 22 years of rich academic experience & expertise in multiple domains is at the helm of affairs. The in-demand technologies are explored, standardized, and incorporated into the training modules. Co-partnering Training Programmes & Academic Partnerships, Linkage with Industries and Organizations, Industrial Visits, In plant Training, Companies associated with the Institution, Distinguished Visitors.
T & P Cell will be continuously working on Industry Interaction, Making Students Placement Ready, Training the students, Performance Tracking of Students, Branding of the College, Development of the Alumni Network.

## Mission

To provide information to the career seeking students about job opportunities, equip them in the relevant skill-sets, offer direction, guidance and support, leading to placement.

## Training  Structure

MGIT envisaged a comprehensive training programme for the students, capsulated and judiciously integrated into their regular curriculum enveloping prime focal areas to produce trainable and employable technology graduates. Training programmes are devised, designed and developed as per the requirements and perspectives of the prospective employers. Training is imparted through interactive sessions and through learner-friendly enjoyable activities in the general areas like:
- Language skills including basic grammar and vocabulary, communication and soft skills, social skills, body language, paralanguage and
- Personality development, quantitative aptitude, arithmetic, verbal and non-verbal reasoning, analogies, numerical abilities, reasoning and
